title: Accepted Docara architecture decisions
summary: Decisions that a new task must not silently reverse.

decisions.decision: Keep specification and graph in the Docara repository, not a separate specs repository.
decisions.reason: Code and contract evolve atomically and avoid drift.

decisions.decision: Use one Markdown file per public route.
decisions.reason: Authors edit the real page source directly.

decisions.decision: Use typed internal IR, never hand-authored JSON content.
decisions.reason: Larena-compatible array processing without burdening Docara authors.

decisions.decision: Use a registry plus one Smart gateway.
decisions.reason: Component behavior is extensible without hardcoded page projectors.

decisions.decision: Use one PageBuilder for all build modes.
decisions.reason: Partial build cannot drift from full build.

decisions.decision: Keep system i18n separate from site and article content.
decisions.reason: Any locale can own its complete documentation without engine edits.

decisions.decision: Do not preserve unpublished legacy storage compatibility.
decisions.reason: The product is still under development and simplicity is the priority.

decisions.decision: Migrate through a badge vertical slice before bulk work.
decisions.reason: Proves the whole architecture with bounded risk.

decisions.decision: Do not use the installed stale Docara skill for this migration.
decisions.reason: It documents the retired Jigsaw/Mix architecture.
